note: The project owner declared ShipBrain and its trained models non-commercial. With this, material under non-commercial licences (PolyForm Noncommercial, CC BY-NC) may be copied, searched and trained on, each item marked NONCOMMERCIAL. If ShipBrain or a model trained with it is ever used commercially, set this to false, remove those items (vendor/*/NONCOMMERCIAL.md, packs marked noncommercial, their training data) and train again.
note_copyleft: The owner also allowed copyleft code (GPL, LGPL, AGPL, MPL) to be searched and trained on. ShipBrain stays open and non-commercial; models trained with it are shared under the same open terms (no closed or commercial version). Runtime dependencies stay free of AGPL. Set copyleft_training to false to go back to search-only.
